text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon and Bitter Glasse wonder what they can do to help Ms. Kashimoto recover from her past trauma and shock.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their solution is to exceed Ms. Kashimoto's expectations for them, even if it means disregarding her warnings and training to the point of recklessness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their goal is not only to help Ms. Kashimoto but to also protect their team and the space they've found for themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But when Ms. Kashimoto realizes that her racers are slipping out of her grasp and defying her, she feels like she's failed as a trainer again.
